lastError.description: Redacted; see the authenticated status endpoint for details.

syncFailures.description: Active producer sync failures, with diagnostics. Omitted when no producer is failing.

info.description: Hand-maintained index of the hub API. Field-level schemas are the Rust types in crates/contracts (serde JSON, snake_case enums); x-roles names who may call. Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>, x-correlation-id (echoed in errors), idempotency-key (ingest).
info.title: fleetix-hub API

200.description: Database and worker are healthy; returns plain text ok

503.description: Database unavailable or worker unhealthy; returns plain text

200.description: Database and worker are healthy and no source has three consecutive sync failures

503.description: Database or worker unhealthy, or a source has at least three consecutive sync failures

post.description: Recall persona-wide and optionally exact-thread memories. Literal, case-insensitive keyword triggers rank first. Sandbox is opt-in.
Compare a hook to the persona's aired memories only.

200.description: NoveltyCheckOut (novelty flag, max similarity, closest memory ID and title)
VoiceExemplar approved by the authenticated operator

post.description: Raw image bytes (maximum 32 MiB); content-type identifies the image.

X-Fleet-Status-Age-Seconds.description: Omitted when snapshot age cannot be trusted

post.description: Raw output bytes from a pipeline procedure. Headers: x-artifact-source, content-type, x-sha256.

schema.description: Absent: a snapshot of the newest open (or all) rows, cursor = high-water mark. Present: the feed of the oldest changes past this cursor; echo the returned cursor to continue without skipping a change.
Seconds to hold the request open until a row matches; capped at 55.

post.description: Preview a judged rewrite without saving it. When applied is false, humanized_text is the exact source text.
